twentyObjects.reason: Frozen Stage 6 ScanPipeline and Stage 7 validator hard-cap 10 objects; no bypass attempted.

coldDefinition: Fresh child per workload; indexes built separately; first scan loads native sessions; OS page cache is not purged. Setup includes authenticated snapshot, index read and reference photo load.
warmDefinition: Two subsequent scans on same resident sessions/index handles.
controlledWorkload: Actual YOLOX runs, but supplied synthetic rectangles drive crop workloads; supplied count is not a detector-accuracy result.
peakMemoryDefinition: Process lifetime high-water RSS per child, includes model/index loading and warm/concurrency scans.
